network: Fast 3G (CDP: 562.5 ms RTT, 1.44 Mbit/s down) + CPU ×4 slowdown (CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate)
objective: Use the site on a slow connection and a slow CPU, including giving up on a slow 3D load and retrying.
device: Galaxy S9+ (Playwright descriptor: 320×658, DPR 4.5, Android UA, touch)
test: journeys\persona-d.spec.js › Persona D — slow network, low-power phone

steps.action: Open the home page on the throttled connection
steps.expected: Main heading readable within 10 s; LCP and CLS recorded
steps.actual: h1 after 2646 ms, load event 7212 ms, LCP 2132 ms, transferred 542 KiB

steps.action: Watch the first screen while the slow page finishes loading
steps.expected: Layout stays put: cumulative layout shift < 0.1

steps.action: Swipe down through the procedure cards (images)
steps.expected: Each card shows an image or its line-drawing fallback; no broken images; page keeps up
steps.actual: cards: img, img, img, img, img, img, img

steps.action: Tap the cataract card's details link
steps.expected: Cataract page opens (content chunk loads over the slow link)

steps.action: Scroll to the 3D section and tap Start
steps.expected: Button immediately shows a busy "جارٍ التحميل…" state

steps.action: Give up while it is still loading: tap the "الرئيسية" breadcrumb
steps.expected: Home page opens; the half-loaded 3D never appears; no errors
steps.actual: Not executed: an earlier critical step failed.

steps.action: Press back to return to the cataract page
steps.expected: Cataract page; 3D section idle with the Start button
steps.actual: Not executed: an earlier critical step failed.
Not executed: an earlier critical step failed.

steps.expected: Stage 4 of 7 shown; buttons respond on the slow CPU
steps.actual: Not executed: an earlier critical step failed.
